universities.query_limit_reconciliation: top=5.Year.Completions.desc retrieves the top 5 years globally ranked by completions for the given university and gender drilldowns (Year, CIP6), while the retained variant restricts the scope to Year=2016,2017,2018 with top=3.Year.Completions.desc, returning the top 3 completion records specifically within those three years.
